'''J-4CK''' was a [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was boasted as to having a [[Sith O' Lantern|"Droid-o-lantern"]] smile.

==Behind the scenes==
J-4CK was a droid purchasable in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]]. It was able to be purchased exclusively during Halloween time. J-4CK appears like the name Jack. Given that the droid was described as having a "Droid-o-lantern" smile, this is likely a reference to the real world jack-o'-lantern.
